description: This file defines the IAVBufferHelper interface class, including memory mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, secure data writing, and copying functions. It provides an abstraction for handling buffer operations related to AV buffers.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: Abstract interface class for buffer helper operations including memory mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, secure data writing, and copying.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a handle and returns a pointer to it, also outputs the size of the mapped data.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a handle and returns success status.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of memory allocated to a handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer associated with a handle. Has a default implementation returning false.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers with specified offset and size mappings. Has a default implementation returning false.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
